five_second.sells: Online art and drawing courses for personal growth and relaxation, branded as a 'Neuro Art School' with a spiritual/manifesting angle
five_second.for_whom: adults looking for a calming creative hobby or a bit of self-improvement, seems mostly aimed at women
five_second.price_guess: somewhere around $50-150 per course, just a guess since nothing was priced on that first screen

features_used.moment: I clicked Courses expecting a shelf of classes with prices like a shop window, and got a list of course names and pretty pictures with no dollar signs anywhere on the whole page

features_used.feature: individual course landing page (Tangle with Ann)
features_used.moment: I opened the Zendala drawing course to find its price and had to scroll through the teacher's story and course description twice before anything about cost showed up
clicking it to see the price jumped me straight into a payment form with a card number box, and the price was tucked in small text there
going back landed me at the true price display near the very bottom of the page, a clean card showing $99 crossed out from $159
I looked at what the membership includes, weekly live sessions and a private group, which felt clear and inviting
clicking the $38 price took me straight to a card-entry form for a 'free' 3-day trial that bills monthly after, which made me uneasy even though it says cancel anytime
going back again showed me the real comparison I wanted: Pay Monthly $38 or Annual $375 with 3 months free
after a long tiring scroll on the Spirals course page with no price ever showing up, I clicked the little logo picture like I always do to get back to somewhere familiar

features_looked_for_but_missing: prices shown right next to each course on the main course list, like price tags in a shop window
a simple one-page list comparing all the course prices side by side
feature_that_most_helped_the_decision: the pricing cards that eventually appeared (course page bottom and membership page bottom) once I scrolled far enough or backed into them, which gave a clear dollar figure
feature_that_most_hurt_the_decision: the main course catalog page, which shows names and photos of every course but not one single price, so I had to open each course and hunt for it

friction.moment: Opened the Courses page expecting a shop shelf with prices and found none anywhere on it
Scrolled through the Tangle with Ann course description and teacher bio twice with no price in sight
The only way to see the Tangle with Ann price at first was to click a 'Pay in US dollars' button that dropped me straight into a payment form with a card number box
Clicking the $38 price on the membership page jumped straight to a checkout asking for card details for a trial marked 'Due Now: Free'
The Power of Spirals course page was very long; I scrolled through testimonials and a section about 'four energies' five times and never reached a price before I gave up on that one

delight.moment: The homepage photo of Anna Denning holding her own artwork felt warm and personal, like a real person runs this, not a faceless company
Finally finding the clean pricing card for Tangle with Ann, $99 marked down from $159, felt like a genuine little discount and a relief after all that scrolling
The membership page's final pricing table, Pay Monthly $38 or Annual $375 with 3 months free, laid the choice out plainly once I reached it

what_earned_it: a real named person (Anna Denning) with her own photo and artwork, not a stock-photo storefront
customer testimonials with names and job titles on the Spirals course page
plain 'subscriptions can be canceled anytime' wording on the membership
working social media links (Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok)
trust.what_it_would_take: put the price right on the course shelf where I first see the course, and don't ask me for a credit card number before I've even been told plainly what a 'free trial' turns into afterward

brand_recall.tell_a_friend_one_sentence: It's a nice-looking online art school by a woman named Anna Denning teaching relaxing drawing courses, but you really have to hunt around the site to find out what anything costs.
brand_recall.product_remembered: Tangle with Ann, a Zendala drawing course
brand_recall.price_remembered: $99 for that drawing course, and I think $38 a month for the membership
